_about: How many questions a master deck asks at each rigor. The candidate picks one before the first build. Raising it adds questions; lowering it hides only unanswered ones. An answered question is never removed. Totals run about 15 / 16 / 17 (light), 31 / 36 / 40 (medium) and 51 / 61 / 69 (heavy) for an individual contributor / manager / executive.

levels.title: Light
levels.pitch: The questions nearly every interview asks. About 15, for a quick tune-up or a first screen.

levels.title: Medium
levels.pitch: A full prep for most interviews. About 30 to 40 questions.

levels.title: Heavy
levels.pitch: Everything, for a final round or a big career move. About 50 to 70 questions.

_fields.opening: In order: tell me about yourself, why are you looking, what are you looking for, what are you doing now, your first 90 days, then one their history invites (why they left, a gap, a career change).
_fields.behavioral.universal: light: the six universal competencies marked light in behavioral.json; all: all ten.
_fields.behavioral.perCompetency: How many of each competency's questions, in the bank's order (the first is the one lighter decks use).
_fields.behavioral.perLeadershipLayer: For the layers the candidate qualifies for (people: manages people; business: senior or executive band). 1: the first light-marked competency in the layer, its first question. all: every competency in the layer, at perCompetency questions each.
_fields.resume: roles: how many of the most recent roles get bullet questions. bulletsPerRole: how many bullets each, the ones with a number first. The master deck has no resume follow-ups; an interview deck adds them.
_fields.ask: Questions to ask, spread across the themes, one per theme before any theme gets a second.
